ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) with high-intensity (white/yellow) localized clusters; estimated ratio 95:5.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous dark pigmentation across the macro-surface. Scattered white point-source pixels and circular rings distributed bilaterally. Large, irregular contiguous clusters of high-intensity pixels (yellow, white, brown) localized at the distal tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with a central convergence angle of approximately 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and asymmetrical. The left lobe trailing edge features high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations. The right lobe trailing edge features jagged, high-amplitude depressions and irregular scalloping.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward curvature along the trailing margins leading to traumatized distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Widespread detection of circular, high-contrast white/grey ring-like clusters (barnacle scars) distributed across the dark integument of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, light-colored linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the medial-distal region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Severe traumatic amputation or tissue loss at the distal tip of the right lobe with heavy yellowish-brown biological encrustation. Significant tissue irregularity and encrustation also present at the left lobe tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent biological fouling (likely cyamids or barnacles) concentrated exclusively on the traumatized distal extremities of the fluke.
